question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage **emphasizes the health benefits of consuming fruits and vegetables.**
 
• **A diet high in fruits and vegetables is known to provide various health benefits**.
 
• "**Rich**" specifically refers to a diet that contains a lot of specific components, which in this context are fruits and vegetables.
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 3 is 'rich.'

Therefore, the correct sentence from the passage should read **"****A diet rich__ in fruit and vegetables can help protect you against cancer, diabetes, and heart disease. Eat five kinds of vegetables and two kinds of fruit every day for good health."***.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Other options ("immersed", "content", "varied") do not fit as appropriately in describing the diet referenced in the passage.

 
• **Immersed (**डूबी हुई): "Immersed" means deeply covered or engaged, which does not fit the description of a diet high in fruits and vegetables.
 
• **Content (**सामग्री): "Content" refers to the things included in something, which does not accurately describe the word needed to convey a diet high in fruits and vegetables.
 
• **Varied** (विविध): "Varied" means having different kinds, which is useful but does not directly convey the idea of a diet high in fruits and vegetables providing health benefits.
